svg.title: Recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes — W03 remediation pilot, not approved
svg.desc: Six numbered bilingual child-facing step panels; draft for independent A08/A09 review. Adult-only actions are explicitly labelled. Per-panel accessibility descriptions are attached to each group.

g.aria-label: Panel 1, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: Mix cooked chicken, corn, egg, flour and milk. Wash hands after touching raw egg; do not taste raw batter. Português: Misture a massa. Lave as mãos depois de tocar no ovo cru; não prove a massa crua.
g.title: Panel 1, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: Mix cooked chicken, corn, egg, flour and milk. Wash hands after touching raw egg; do not taste raw batter. Português: Misture a massa. Lave as mãos depois de tocar no ovo cru; não prove a massa crua.

use.aria-label: Approved Chef A portrait, consistent safe-step guide

g.text: Wash hands after egg • Lave as mãos após tocar no ovo
Do not taste raw batter • Não prove a massa crua

g.aria-label: Panel 2, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: An adult puts small spoonfuls into the lightly oiled pan. Adult-only action. Safety: Hot pan: adult only. Português: Um adulto coloca a massa na frigideira.
g.title: Panel 2, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: An adult puts small spoonfuls into the lightly oiled pan. Adult-only action. Safety: Hot pan: adult only. Português: Um adulto coloca a massa na frigideira.
g.text: Um adulto coloca a massa na frigideira
Adult at hot pan • Adulto na panela

g.aria-label: Panel 3, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: An adult cooks the pancakes until their centres are fully cooked. Adult-only action. Safety: Hot pan: adult only. Português: Um adulto cozinha as panquequinhas.
g.title: Panel 3, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: An adult cooks the pancakes until their centres are fully cooked. Adult-only action. Safety: Hot pan: adult only. Português: Um adulto cozinha as panquequinhas.

g.text: Adult at hot pan • Adulto na panela

g.aria-label: Panel 4, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: An adult flips the pancakes with a spatula. Adult-only action. Safety: Hot pan and spatula: adult only. Português: Um adulto vira cada panquequinha.
g.title: Panel 4, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: An adult flips the pancakes with a spatula. Adult-only action. Safety: Hot pan and spatula: adult only. Português: Um adulto vira cada panquequinha.

g.text: Adult at hot pan • Adulto na panela

g.aria-label: Panel 5, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: An adult checks that the middle is cooked through. Keep uncooked batter away from ready-to-eat food. Adult-only action. Português: Um adulto confere o centro. Mantenha a massa crua longe dos alimentos prontos para comer.
g.title: Panel 5, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: An adult checks that the middle is cooked through. Keep uncooked batter away from ready-to-eat food. Adult-only action. Português: Um adulto confere o centro. Mantenha a massa crua longe dos alimentos prontos para comer.
g.text: Keep raw batter away from ready food
Mantenha a massa crua longe da comida pronta

g.aria-label: Panel 6, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: Let the pancakes cool before they are served. Safety: Wait until food is comfortably cool. Português: Espere esfriar antes de servir.
g.title: Panel 6, recipe 39 Chicken & Corn Mini Pancakes. English: Let the pancakes cool before they are served. Safety: Wait until food is comfortably cool. Português: Espere esfriar antes de servir.
